🎥🎬: Blue Eye Samurai – Season 2 (2027)

Following her bloody journey through Japan, Mizu sets sail for London in pursuit of the two remaining men who could be her father. Determined to complete her revenge, she enters a completely unfamiliar world where her sword skills will be tested against new enemies, dangerous alliances, and a society that sees her as an outsider.

Meanwhile, back in Japan, Akemi and Taigen find themselves navigating the dangerous political world of Edo Castle under a new and powerful Shogun. Ringo, who once dreamed of becoming a great swordmaker, begins searching for a new purpose as the lives of those left behind continue to change.

As Mizu’s revenge mission takes her beyond Japan, she must confront new enemies and her own inner demons while discovering that the world is far more complicated than she imagined. The journey for vengeance continues, but the cost may be greater than anything she has faced before.
